transcript.content: Hello, welcome. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I’m here because I just… don’t care about anything anymore. I used to go to art classes, board-game nights, hiking, and I was thinking about getting back on the soccer team, but now I don’t do any of it. I mostly just sit in my room and let everything slip away.
Have you lost interest or pleasure in all activities, even the ones you used to enjoy?

Yes. I don’t really get pleasure from any of it anymore. Art classes, board-game nights, hiking… even the idea of playing soccer again, it all just feels like nothing. I mostly stay in my room and let it all pass by.
How long have you been feeling this way, where you don’t take pleasure in things and mostly stay in your room?
It’s been a long time. It really became constant around the next summer, and it’s been about a year and four months now. Since then I’ve mostly just been in my room, not enjoying things.
Have you had a consistently low mood for more than two years now?
No, not more than two years. It’s been about a year and four months since it became constant, around that following summer.

No, not for two years. It’s been more like about a year and four months since it became constant, around that following summer.

No, not for two years. Like I said, it got constant around that next summer, and it’s been about a year and four months.

I’ve definitely been exhausted nearly every day. Even if I’ve been in bed half the day, just taking a shower or answering one message can feel like I worked a full shift. But I can’t really say it’s been at least two years.

Yeah, nearly every day. Most mornings I wake up with this heavy, hollow feeling in my chest, like there’s no real future for me beyond my apartment walls.

Not for the full two years, no. It got to where it was constant around the following summer, and it’s been like that about a year and four months.

It started more recently than that. It became constant around the following summer, and it’s been going on like that for about a year and four months.

More recently than that. I mean, it’s been nearly every day since around the following summer, so about a year and four months now.
